thread:
Olivia (Onboarding): quick heads-up — I uploaded the Mistral Labs pilot starter pack to the shared drive and dropped the one-pager in #pilot-artifacts. Need volunteers for: enablement call, kickoff notes, and collecting first-week feedback. Can we get owners by EOD tomorrow? :wave:
Miguel (CS): I can own kickoff notes and set up the feedback tracker in Notion. will sync with Asha about the enablement agenda.
Asha (Enablement): happy to run the enablement call. prefer Tue 10am PT or Wed 2pm PT. proposal: 30m demo + 15m Q&A + 15m setup time with devs.
Sam (Account): putting Tue 10am PT as tentative — Mistral's PM said they'd prefer mornings. i'll confirm time and send calendar invite once Asha confirms.
Priya (Renewals): heads-up — this account has a soft renewal in 9 months and reported platform-cost concerns in the last call. let's flag any product blockers from week1 that could surface as churn risks. i'll draft a risk checklist.
Olivia (Onboarding): thanks all. Miguel, can you add these three items into the tracker: enablement owner, kickoff notes owner, feedback form owner? also add a field for "initial risk flags" per Priya.
Miguel (CS): done — tracker entry created: https://notion.redwood/integrations/mistral-pilot. columns: owner, due, status, feedback-link, risk-tags.
Asha (Enablement): agenda draft:
```
- 5m intro + goals
- 20m platform walkthrough (key flows for their use-case)
- 10m integration checklist (API keys, network allowlist)
- 15m Q&A + next steps
```
Can someone paste the integration checklist items (network, KMS, deploy token) into the tracker?
Sam (Account): adding integration checklist items now. also pinged infra to confirm VPC peering window — they said Fri morning is fine.
Priya (Renewals): added a renewal-risk column to the tracker and a checkbox for "cost sensitivity" + "SLA need". i'll own weekly risk scoping for first 4 weeks.
Olivia (Onboarding): feedback form (short) — Miguel you own link, Asha you own live feedback capture during call. proposed form fields: role, primary flow tried, 3 quick pain points, NPS (0-10), ok to share logs?
Miguel (CS): feedback form link added: https://forms.redwood/guest/mistral-week1. short version with required: role, primary flow, 3 pain points, rating. optional: logs consent.
Asha (Enablement): on the call i'll use this script excerpt for live capture:
```
- Ask: what did you expect to happen?
- Observe: where flow diverged
- Note: any blocking errors + repro steps
- Capture: permission to pull logs (yes/no)
```
Priya (Renewals): small ask — if cost concerns show up, escalate to me immediately and mark "cost" in risk-tags. i'll prep a quick cost-comparison note for them (baseline vs optimized config).
Olivia (Onboarding): cs-bot scheduled reminder for the team: kickoff pre-brief 24h before call. Miguel — can you post a 3-line summary to #customer-updates after the call?
cs-bot: Reminder set: "Pilot pre-brief: Mistral Labs" scheduled for 2026-07-21T17:00:00Z — will notify #customer-success and the assignees listed in the tracker. :bell:
Sam (Account): confirmed calendar invite sent to Mistral PM for Tue 10am PT. added Asha, Miguel, Olivia.
Miguel (CS): will capture notes and drop them in tracker post-call. tagging @Priya for any cost flags.
Olivia (Onboarding): perfect — thanks everyone. next check-in here after the call. :seedling:
